config router prefix-list

            edit 1
                set prefix 198.51.100.0 255.255.255.0
                unset ge
                set le 32
            next
        end
    next
    edit "upstream-origins"
        set comments "Filled by circuit refresh from ripe-stat AS64501"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set prefix 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
                unset ge
                set le 32
                set action deny
            next
        end
    next
    edit "circuit-length-25-32"

                set prefix 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
                set ge 25
                set le 32
            next
        end

config router community-list
    edit "circuit-match-64501-666"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set action permit
                set match "64501:666"
            next
        end
    next
    edit "circuit-match-64500-999"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set action permit
                set match "64500:999"
            next
        end
    next
    edit "circuit-remove-64500-any"
        set type expanded
        config rule
            edit 1
                set action permit
                set regexp "^64500:[0-9]+$"
            next
        end
    next
end
config router route-map
    edit "UPSTREAM-IN"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set match-ip-address "circuit-length-25-32"
                set action deny
            next
            edit 2
                set match-community "circuit-match-64501-666"
                set action deny
            next
            edit 3
                set match-ip-address "UPSTREAM-IN-3"
                set set-local-preference 200
                set set-community "64500:100"
                set set-community-additive enable
            next
            edit 4
                set match-ip-address "upstream-origins"
                set set-metric 10
            next
        end
    next
    edit "UPSTREAM-OUT"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set match-community "circuit-match-64500-999"
                set action deny
            next
            edit 2
                set match-ip-address "ours-0-24"
                set set-aspath "64500"
                set set-community-delete "circuit-remove-64500-any"
                set set-ip-nexthop 203.0.113.10
            next
        end
    next
    edit "UPSTREAM-IN-v6"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set match-ip6-address "circuit-length-25-128"
                set action deny
            next
            edit 2
                set match-community "circuit-match-64501-666"
                set action deny
            next
        end
    next
    edit "UPSTREAM-OUT-v6"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set match-community "circuit-match-64500-999"
                set action deny
            next
            edit 2
                set set-community "64501:100"
            next
        end
    next
    edit "circuit-reject-all"
        config rule
            edit 1
                set action deny
            next
        end
    next
end

config router bgp
    set as 64500
    set router-id 198.51.100.255
    config neighbor
        edit "203.0.113.9"
            set activate6 disable
            set bfd enable
            set description "Transit"
            set remote-as 64501
            set maximum-prefix 1000
            set route-map-in "UPSTREAM-IN"
            set route-map-out "UPSTREAM-OUT"
            set password "<secret:EXAMPLE_BGP_PASSWORD>"
        next
        edit "2001:db8:fff0::1"
            set activate disable
            set bfd enable
            set remote-as 64501
            set maximum-prefix6 1000
            set route-map-in6 "UPSTREAM-IN-v6"
            set route-map-out6 "UPSTREAM-OUT-v6"
            set password "<secret:EXAMPLE_BGP_PASSWORD>"
        next
        edit "192.0.2.130"
            set activate6 disable
            set ebgp-enforce-multihop enable
            set passive enable
            set remote-as 64500
            set route-map-in "circuit-reject-all"
            set route-map-out "circuit-reject-all"
            set keep-alive-timer 30
            set holdtime-timer 90
            set update-source "loopback"
        next
    end
    config network
        edit 1
            set prefix 198.51.100.0 255.255.255.0
        next
    end
end

        set service "tcp/25,465,587"

        set comments "No SMTP out"
        set send-deny-packet enable
    next
